title: The Earthquake
text:
Yesterday, an earthquake shook our town at noon. The ground moved for almost one minute. Many people ran outside because they were scared. Glasses and plates fell from the shelves.

After the earthquake, the firefighters came to help. They checked the old houses and gave water to the families. The people were tired, but they were thankful for the help. Our town will now build stronger buildings.

questions.text: How long did the ground move?
Who came to help after the earthquake?
How did the people probably feel during the earthquake?
What can we infer about the town's future?
options: It will not build any more buildings
It will try to make safer buildings
It will move to another country
It will stop caring about safety

vocabulary.definition: a sudden shaking of the ground
people whose job is to put out fires

paragraph_translations: Dün öğle vakti bir deprem kasabamızı sarstı. Zemin neredeyse bir dakika boyunca hareket etti. Birçok insan korktukları için dışarı koştu. Raflardan bardaklar ve tabaklar düştü.
Depremden sonra itfaiyeciler yardıma geldi. Eski evleri kontrol ettiler ve ailelere su verdiler. İnsanlar yorgundu, ama yardım için minnettardılar. Kasabamız artık daha sağlam binalar inşa edecek.
